speaker: Doctor
text: I have noted your chief complaint of progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. To understand the onset and nature of this inflammation, please describe how the pain started and if you have noticed any redness, warmth, or difficulty bending the finger.

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gamekeeper's Thumb (Stable Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injury). The mechanism of injury—your finger being caught and forcefully pulled during football—is the classic presentation for a ligament tear, and your ring finger is adjacent to the thumb, often injured in this specific type of traction injury.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
